name: Israel
shortSummary: India and Israel have built a close defence and technology partnership since establishing full diplomatic relations in 1992, with Israel a top-three supplier of Indian military equipment including missile defence and drone systems.
complexity: India has traditionally balanced strong Israel ties with longstanding support for Palestinian statehood, a position tested amid the 2023-25 Gaza war, during which India provided humanitarian aid to Gaza while deepening defence ties with Israel.

majorAreasOfCooperation.description: Missile defence, drones and precision-guided munitions form the backbone of the relationship.
Israeli drip-irrigation and precision farming techniques are deployed across Indian Centres of Excellence.

majorChallenges.title: Israel-Palestine balance
majorChallenges.description: India seeks to maintain defence and technology ties with Israel while continuing to support a two-state solution for Palestine.

recentDevelopments.title: Gaza war reshapes regional context
recentDevelopments.description: Following the October 2023 Hamas attack and subsequent Gaza war, India condemned terrorism while continuing to call for humanitarian access and a two-state solution, even as thousands of Indian workers took up construction jobs in Israel amid labour shortages.
recentDevelopments.whyItMatters: Tested India's traditional balancing act between close Israeli defence ties and longstanding support for Palestinian statehood.

recentDevelopments.title: Defence and agri-tech cooperation continues
recentDevelopments.description: Core defence procurement and agricultural technology cooperation continued largely unaffected by the regional conflict.
recentDevelopments.whyItMatters: Shows the bilateral relationship's institutional ties proved resilient through a highly volatile regional period.

historicalEvents.title: Establishment of Full Diplomatic Relations
historicalEvents.description: India and Israel establish full diplomatic relations after decades of limited engagement following India's independence.

historicalEvents.title: First Indian Prime Ministerial Visit
historicalEvents.description: PM Modi becomes the first Indian prime minister to visit Israel, marking a symbolic deepening of ties.

historicalEvents.title: I2U2 Grouping Formed
historicalEvents.description: India, Israel, the UAE and the US launch the I2U2 grouping to coordinate infrastructure and technology investment.

historicalEvents.title: Gaza War and Indian Workforce Deployment
historicalEvents.description: Following the October 7 Hamas attack and subsequent Gaza war, India expresses condemnation of terrorism while calling for humanitarian access; thousands of Indian workers subsequently take up construction jobs in Israel amid labour shortages.

agreements.name: Agriculture Cooperation MoU / Centres of Excellence
agreements.description: Framework establishing Indo-Israel Agriculture Project Centres of Excellence across Indian states.

defenceCooperation.name: Heron and Searcher drones
defenceCooperation.description: Israeli-made unmanned aerial systems widely used by the Indian armed forces.
